name: Hand Demo Clip
description: A five second handheld clip of one hand picking the product up and turning it to camera. Starts from a still you already have.
prompt: Handheld phone video: a hand picks up {{product}} from {{surface}}, turns it toward the camera, thumb taps the cap, soft daylight, slight camera shake, real kitchen ambience
negative_prompt: extra hands, morphing fingers, warped label, text, captions

slots.name: product
slots.label: Product image
slots.help: An Element image or any still of the product; it becomes the first frame.

author: kilnry
